scenes.title: Passport
scenes.caption: How to renew your adult passport.
scenes.say: Passport running out? Here's how to renew an adult passport, without any fuss.

scenes.title: The cost
scenes.caption: Online costs £88.50. Paper costs £100.
scenes.say: Renewing online costs eighty-eight pounds fifty. A paper form from the Post Office costs one hundred pounds.

scenes.title: What you need
scenes.caption: A photo, a card, and your old passport.
scenes.say: You'll need a digital photo of yourself, a credit or debit card, and your old passport.

scenes.title: Your photo
scenes.caption: Clear, in focus, no smile, no glasses.
scenes.say: Keep the photo clear and in focus. Face uncovered, no smiling, no tilted head, and no glasses.

scenes.title: Post it back
scenes.caption: Your application starts when your old passport arrives.
scenes.say: After you apply, post your old passport to them. Nothing starts until it arrives, and you get it back cancelled.

scenes.title: Allow 3 weeks
scenes.caption: It usually takes up to 3 weeks.
scenes.say: It usually takes up to three weeks, sometimes longer. Don't book travel until your new passport is in your hand.

scenes.title: In a hurry?
scenes.caption: Lost or stolen? Report it and apply for a replacement.
scenes.say: If yours is lost or stolen, report it and apply for a replacement. In a hurry, Fast Track takes one week and costs one hundred seventy-eight pounds.
